CREATE TABLE ReadingPlan (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, BookId INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES Book(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, StartDate BIGINT NOT NULL, TargetDate BIGINT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE ReadingRecord (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, BookId INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES Book(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ReadingDate BIGINT NOT NULL, StartPage INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(StartPage>=1), EndPage INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(EndPage>=StartPage), Minutes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Minutes>0));
